text: Start with a real service, not a big claim.
Your brand should help someone understand whether you can serve their needs.
In our fictional example, Alex offers haircut consultations and grooming services.
Saying, I am the best, gives the client very little information.
A clearer statement is: I help clients who want a manageable haircut explore a style and maintenance routine that fit their day.
Name the people you serve, the need you address and the service you can actually deliver.
Remove a claim you cannot support.
Pause the audio, write one sentence and read it as a new client would.
